Bug_Title: RANGE: String index is out of bounds (RANGE_STRING_INDEX)
Bug_Details: String method is called and specified string index is out of bounds. This will result in StringIndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded by attempting to access the character at index 5 of the input string without checking if the string length is sufficient. If the string length is less than 6, this will result in a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases trigger the bug by passing strings shorter than 6 characters to the showBug method, leading to a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
